#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    map<int, int> freq;
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
        if (even == odd) {
            int cost = abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]);
            ++freq[cost];
        }
    }

    int sum = 0, taken = 0, ans = 0;
    for (auto &entry : freq) {
        int cost = entry.first;
        int count = entry.second;
        for (int t = 0; t < count; ++t) {
            sum += cost;
            ++taken;
            if (sum <= b) {
                ans = taken;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
